header.sector: Passive and electronic components (MLCC, VCSEL, connectors)
header.title: AI-driven CPU and DDR5 demand creates high-capacitance MLCC shortage lifting supplier pricing

s01_bottom_line.text: AI inference and agent workloads drive CPU, power module and DDR5 proliferation, raising high-capacitance MLCC demand; TrendForce expects high-end MLCC shortages most severe in 1Q27-2Q27 and extending through 1H27, letting suppliers hold pricing power.

The shortage allows suppliers to retain the upper hand in pricing negotiations through 1H27, with Japanese makers likely following SEMCO's price increases and Taiwanese/Chinese suppliers gaining spillover consumer-grade orders.
High-capacitance/AI-grade MLCC suppliers such as Murata and SEMCO likely see firm or rising ASPs and favorable negotiating leverage through 1H27; the article quantifies no earnings or margin impact.

items.text: ODMs anticipate high-end MLCC shortages will be most severe in 1Q27 and 2Q27.
TrendForce expects the high-end MLCC shortage to extend through 1H27, keeping suppliers in a strong pricing position.
NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform shipments are expected to ramp up month by month starting 4Q26.
AMD is beginning to procure specialized high-capacitance MLCCs for its MI450 platform.
Japanese MLCC manufacturers appear increasingly likely to follow SEMCO in raising prices.
Taiwanese and Chinese suppliers are expected to continue benefiting from spillover orders for consumer-grade MLCCs.
